description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for the 'git' command, specifically testing the behavior of the '-C <path>' option and its interactions with other options like '--git-dir' and '--work-tree'. It sets up repositories, executes git commands with different parameter combinations, and verifies expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A test framework method to define a test case expecting success, takes a description and a shell command sequence.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: A helper function to initialize a new git repository at a specified directory.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: A function to compare actual output to expected output, used for assertions.
